assertions.assertion: The web app uses .WithEnvironment("Authentication__Authority", identityServer.GetEndpoint("https")) or an equivalent expression using GetEndpoint
The web app uses .WithEnvironment("Authentication__ClientId", ...) with a client ID value
assertions.rationale: It sets .WithEnvironment("Authentication__ClientId", "web-app") with a concrete client ID.

assertions.assertion: The web app passes at least one scope via .WithEnvironment("Authentication__Scopes__0", ...) using the double-underscore array indexing convention
assertions.rationale: It passes Authentication__Scopes__0/__1/__2 using the double-underscore array indexing convention.

assertions.assertion: The API uses .WithEnvironment("Authentication__Authority", ...) with GetEndpoint for the authority URL
The code does NOT set IssuerUri unless explicitly needed
assertions.rationale: IssuerUri is never set anywhere in the response.
